panels.title: This week against last week
panels.description: Week to date (Monday, Bangkok time) against the last full week, so early in the week the change reads low. A blank cell means no samples that week. Source: the Lookout tables and the host samples.

targets.rawSql: select metric, this_week as "this week", last_week as "last week", round((100.0 * (this_week - last_week) / nullif(last_week, 0))::numeric, 0) as change_pct from (select 0 as ord, 'Cards delivered' as metric, coalesce(max(v) filter (where time = (date_trunc('week', now() at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok') at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok')), 0) as this_week, coalesce(max(v) filter (where time = (date_trunc('week', now() at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok') at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok' - interval '1 week')), 0) as last_week from (select (date_trunc('week', completed_at at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok') at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok') as time, count(*)::float as v from cap_cards where phase = 'done' and completed_at is not null and completed_at > now() - interval '8 weeks' group by 1) w union all select 1 as ord, 'First-pass review rate (%)' as metric, max(v) filter (where time = (date_trunc('week', now() at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok') at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok')) as this_week, max(v) filter (where time = (date_trunc('week', now() at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok') at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok' - interval '1 week')) as last_week from (select (date_trunc('week', completed_at at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok') at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok') as time, round((100.0 * avg((review_rounds <= 1)::int))::numeric, 1)::float as v from cap_cards where phase = 'done' and completed_at is not null and completed_at > now() - interval '8 weeks' group by 1) w union all select 2 as ord, 'Median lead time per card (hours)' as metric, max(v) filter (where time = (date_trunc('week', now() at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok') at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok')) as this_week, max(v) filter (where time = (date_trunc('week', now() at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok') at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok' - interval '1 week')) as last_week from (select (date_trunc('week', completed_at at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok') at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok') as time, round((percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by extract(epoch from completed_at - created_at) / 3600))::numeric, 1)::float as v from cap_cards where phase = 'done' and completed_at is not null and completed_at > now() - interval '8 weeks' and created_at is not null group by 1) w union all select 3 as ord, 'Incidents opened' as metric, coalesce(max(v) filter (where time = (date_trunc('week', now() at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok') at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok')), 0) as this_week, coalesce(max(v) filter (where time = (date_trunc('week', now() at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok') at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok' - interval '1 week')), 0) as last_week from (select time, opened as v from (select (date_trunc('week', opened_at at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok') at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok') as time, count(*)::float as opened, count(repeat_of)::float as repeats from cap_incidents where opened_at > now() - interval '8 weeks' group by 1) i) w union all select 4 as ord, 'Repeat incidents' as metric, coalesce(max(v) filter (where time = (date_trunc('week', now() at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok') at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok')), 0) as this_week, coalesce(max(v) filter (where time = (date_trunc('week', now() at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok') at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok' - interval '1 week')), 0) as last_week from (select time, repeats as v from (select (date_trunc('week', opened_at at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok') at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok') as time, count(*)::float as opened, count(repeat_of)::float as repeats from cap_incidents where opened_at > now() - interval '8 weeks' group by 1) i) w union all select 5 as ord, 'Interventions per card' as metric, max(v) filter (where time = (date_trunc('week', now() at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok') at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok')) as this_week, max(v) filter (where time = (date_trunc('week', now() at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok') at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok' - interval '1 week')) as last_week from (select d.time, round((coalesce(n.v, 0) / nullif(d.v, 0))::numeric, 2)::float as v from (select (date_trunc('week', completed_at at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok') at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok') as time, count(*)::float as v from cap_cards where phase = 'done' and completed_at is not null and completed_at > now() - interval '8 weeks' group by 1) d left join (select (date_trunc('week', ts at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok') at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok') as time, count(*)::float as v from events where kind = 'card' and payload->>'event' = 'intervention' and coalesce(payload->>'author', '') <> 'cos' and coalesce(payload->>'tag', '') not in ('migration-reset', 'handover-route') and ts > now() - interval '8 weeks' group by 1) n on n.time = d.time) w union all select 6 as ord, 'Fresh tokens per delivered card' as metric, max(v) filter (where time = (date_trunc('week', now() at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok') at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok')) as this_week, max(v) filter (where time = (date_trunc('week', now() at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok') at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok' - interval '1 week')) as last_week from (select d.time, round((coalesce(n.v, 0) / nullif(d.v, 0))::numeric, 2)::float as v from (select (date_trunc('week', completed_at at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok') at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok') as time, count(*)::float as v from cap_cards where phase = 'done' and completed_at is not null and completed_at > now() - interval '8 weeks' group by 1) d left join (select (date_trunc('week', c.completed_at at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok') at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok') as time, sum(coalesce(r.tokens_in, 0) + coalesce(r.tokens_out, 0) + coalesce(r.tokens_cache_write, 0))::float as v from cap_runs r join cap_cards c on c.board = r.board and c.task_id = r.task_id where c.phase = 'done' and c.completed_at > now() - interval '8 weeks' and r.era = 'capsule' group by 1) n on n.time = d.time) w union all select 7 as ord, 'Disk free (%)' as metric, max(v) filter (where time = (date_trunc('week', now() at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok') at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok')) as this_week, max(v) filter (where time = (date_trunc('week', now() at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok') at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok' - interval '1 week')) as last_week from (select (date_trunc('week', ts at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok') at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok') as time, round((sum((100 - value) * n) / sum(n))::numeric, 1)::float as v from (select bucket as ts, avg_value as value, n from samples_hourly where name = 'capsule.host.disk.pct' and bucket > now() - interval '8 weeks') s group by 1) w union all select 8 as ord, 'Host load, 1 minute' as metric, max(v) filter (where time = (date_trunc('week', now() at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok') at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok')) as this_week, max(v) filter (where time = (date_trunc('week', now() at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok') at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok' - interval '1 week')) as last_week from (select (date_trunc('week', ts at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok') at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok') as time, round((sum((value) * n) / sum(n))::numeric, 2)::float as v from (select bucket as ts, avg_value as value, n from samples_hourly where name = 'capsule.host.load1' and bucket > now() - interval '8 weeks') s group by 1) w union all select 9 as ord, 'Containers CPU (%)' as metric, max(v) filter (where time = (date_trunc('week', now() at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok') at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok')) as this_week, max(v) filter (where time = (date_trunc('week', now() at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok') at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok' - interval '1 week')) as last_week from (select (date_trunc('week', ts at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok') at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok') as time, round((sum((value) * ticks) / sum(ticks))::numeric, 1)::float as v from (select bucket as ts, sum(total_avg) as value, max(ticks) as ticks from samples_hourly where name = 'capsule.container.cpu.pct' and bucket > now() - interval '8 weeks' group by bucket) s group by 1) w union all select 10 as ord, 'Containers memory (GB)' as metric, max(v) filter (where time = (date_trunc('week', now() at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok') at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok')) as this_week, max(v) filter (where time = (date_trunc('week', now() at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok') at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok' - interval '1 week')) as last_week from (select (date_trunc('week', ts at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok') at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok') as time, round(((sum((value) * ticks) / sum(ticks)) / 1e9)::numeric, 2)::float as v from (select bucket as ts, sum(total_avg) as value, max(ticks) as ticks from samples_hourly where name = 'capsule.container.mem.bytes' and bucket > now() - interval '8 weeks' group by bucket) s group by 1) w union all select 11 as ord, 'Tool denials' as metric, coalesce(max(v) filter (where time = (date_trunc('week', now() at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok') at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok')), 0) as this_week, coalesce(max(v) filter (where time = (date_trunc('week', now() at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok') at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok' - interval '1 week')), 0) as last_week from (select (date_trunc('week', ts at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok') at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok') as time, count(*)::float as v from events where kind = 'card' and payload->>'event' = 'crashed' and jsonb_typeof(payload->'denied_tools') = 'array' and jsonb_array_length(payload->'denied_tools') > 0 and ts > now() - interval '8 weeks' group by 1) w) s order by ord

panels.title: Cards delivered per week
panels.description: Cards that reached done, by the week they completed.

targets.rawSql: select (date_trunc('week', completed_at at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok') at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok') as time, count(*)::float as v from cap_cards where phase = 'done' and completed_at is not null and completed_at > now() - interval '8 weeks' group by 1

panels.title: First-pass review rate
panels.description: Share of delivered cards that needed one implementer round (review_rounds of 1 or less).

targets.rawSql: select (date_trunc('week', completed_at at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok') at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok') as time, round((100.0 * avg((review_rounds <= 1)::int))::numeric, 1)::float as v from cap_cards where phase = 'done' and completed_at is not null and completed_at > now() - interval '8 weeks' group by 1

panels.title: Median lead time per card
panels.description: Created to completed, median of the cards delivered that week.

targets.rawSql: select (date_trunc('week', completed_at at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok') at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok') as time, round((percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by extract(epoch from completed_at - created_at) / 3600))::numeric, 1)::float as v from cap_cards where phase = 'done' and completed_at is not null and completed_at > now() - interval '8 weeks' and created_at is not null group by 1

panels.title: Incidents opened and repeats
panels.description: Opened per week; repeats reopen the same fingerprint within 30 days of a close (repeat_of is set).

targets.rawSql: select (date_trunc('week', opened_at at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok') at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok') as time, count(*)::float as opened, count(repeat_of)::float as repeats from cap_incidents where opened_at > now() - interval '8 weeks' group by 1

panels.title: Interventions per delivered card
panels.description: Human step-ins (intervention events) divided by cards delivered in the same week.

targets.rawSql: select d.time, round((coalesce(n.v, 0) / nullif(d.v, 0))::numeric, 2)::float as v from (select (date_trunc('week', completed_at at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok') at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok') as time, count(*)::float as v from cap_cards where phase = 'done' and completed_at is not null and completed_at > now() - interval '8 weeks' group by 1) d left join (select (date_trunc('week', ts at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok') at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok') as time, count(*)::float as v from events where kind = 'card' and payload->>'event' = 'intervention' and coalesce(payload->>'author', '') <> 'cos' and coalesce(payload->>'tag', '') not in ('migration-reset', 'handover-route') and ts > now() - interval '8 weeks' group by 1) n on n.time = d.time

panels.title: Fresh tokens per delivered card
panels.description: Input, output and cache-write tokens of every run on cards delivered that week, divided by cards delivered.

targets.rawSql: select d.time, round((coalesce(n.v, 0) / nullif(d.v, 0))::numeric, 2)::float as v from (select (date_trunc('week', completed_at at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok') at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok') as time, count(*)::float as v from cap_cards where phase = 'done' and completed_at is not null and completed_at > now() - interval '8 weeks' group by 1) d left join (select (date_trunc('week', c.completed_at at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok') at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok') as time, sum(coalesce(r.tokens_in, 0) + coalesce(r.tokens_out, 0) + coalesce(r.tokens_cache_write, 0))::float as v from cap_runs r join cap_cards c on c.board = r.board and c.task_id = r.task_id where c.phase = 'done' and c.completed_at > now() - interval '8 weeks' and r.era = 'capsule' group by 1) n on n.time = d.time

panels.title: Disk free
panels.description: Weekly average of free space on the factory volume.

targets.rawSql: select (date_trunc('week', ts at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok') at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok') as time, round((sum((100 - value) * n) / sum(n))::numeric, 1)::float as v from (select bucket as ts, avg_value as value, n from samples_hourly where name = 'capsule.host.disk.pct' and bucket > now() - interval '8 weeks') s group by 1

select (date_trunc('week', ts at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok') at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok') as time, round((sum((value) * n) / sum(n))::numeric, 2)::float as v from (select bucket as ts, avg_value as value, n from samples_hourly where name = 'capsule.host.load1' and bucket > now() - interval '8 weeks') s group by 1

panels.title: Containers CPU
panels.description: Weekly average of all containers' CPU, summed.

targets.rawSql: select (date_trunc('week', ts at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok') at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok') as time, round((sum((value) * ticks) / sum(ticks))::numeric, 1)::float as v from (select bucket as ts, sum(total_avg) as value, max(ticks) as ticks from samples_hourly where name = 'capsule.container.cpu.pct' and bucket > now() - interval '8 weeks' group by bucket) s group by 1

panels.title: Containers memory
panels.description: Weekly average of all containers' memory, summed.

targets.rawSql: select (date_trunc('week', ts at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok') at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok') as time, round(((sum((value) * ticks) / sum(ticks)) / 1e9)::numeric, 2)::float as v from (select bucket as ts, sum(total_avg) as value, max(ticks) as ticks from samples_hourly where name = 'capsule.container.mem.bytes' and bucket > now() - interval '8 weeks' group by bucket) s group by 1

panels.title: Epics refused: secret found
panels.description: Right now, epics whose PR the publisher refused because a secret was found. A snapshot, not a weekly history.

targets.rawSql: select count(*)::float as "epics" from cap_epics where publish_state = 'refused' and publish_reason = 'secret_found'

panels.title: Epics refused: GitHub login
panels.description: Right now, epics refused because gh is not logged in. A snapshot, not a weekly history.

targets.rawSql: select count(*)::float as "epics" from cap_epics where publish_state = 'refused' and publish_reason = 'gh_auth'

panels.title: Tool denials
panels.description: Runs that crashed after a tool call was denied (the agent guard). The only denial record in ops-pg.

targets.rawSql: select (date_trunc('week', ts at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok') at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok') as time, count(*)::float as v from events where kind = 'card' and payload->>'event' = 'crashed' and jsonb_typeof(payload->'denied_tools') = 'array' and jsonb_array_length(payload->'denied_tools') > 0 and ts > now() - interval '8 weeks' group by 1

select (date_trunc('week', ts at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok') at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok') as time, count(*)::float as v from events where kind = 'card' and payload->>'event' = 'override' and ts > now() - interval '8 weeks' group by 1

select (date_trunc('week', ts at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok') at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok') as time, count(*)::float as v from events where kind = 'card' and payload->>'event' = 'override_refused' and ts > now() - interval '8 weeks' group by 1

panels.title: Overrides expired
panels.description: Override grants, by the week they run out (expires_at).

targets.rawSql: select (date_trunc('week', to_timestamp((payload->>'expires_at')::float) at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok') at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok') as time, count(*)::float as v from events where kind = 'card' and payload->>'event' = 'override' and jsonb_typeof(payload->'expires_at') = 'number' and to_timestamp((payload->>'expires_at')::float) > now() - interval '8 weeks' group by 1

panels.title: Security incidents
panels.description: Incidents opened per week of kind main_checkout_write, two_dispatchers or lost_card_state.

targets.rawSql: select (date_trunc('week', opened_at at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok') at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok') as time, count(*)::float as v from cap_incidents where kind in ('main_checkout_write', 'two_dispatchers', 'lost_card_state') and opened_at > now() - interval '8 weeks' group by 1
